title: A Semi-Lagrangian Spherical Essentially Non-Oscillatory (SENO) Scheme for Advection Equations of S2-valued Functions
summary: We develop a numerical scheme for solving the advection equation of $\mathbb{S}^2$-valued functions of real variables, which models the time-evolution of a $\mathbb{S}^2$-valued mapping on the real line by a known velocity field. The idea is to extend the semi-Lagrangian method for the linear scalar advection equation. We first construct the backward flow map between two adjacent time levels and then interpolate the discrete ordered data of $\mathbb{S}^2$.
